name: tankoban-catalogue-smoke
comment: Catalogue-independence Slices 2-4 (2026-08-20). Closes the runtime debt Slice 3 left open (its own committed version stopped at Tankoban entry, honestly, after finding the WorldTabBar Repeater materialized only 1 of 4 modeled tab pills). A dedicated diagnosis pass (sessions 20260820-162647-95a9507f, 20260820-163420-9f431989) proved a driven click sequence DOES reach tankobanTab_manga live even though a bare qml-get/ui-wait-for against it timed out in isolation — see the dump-ui-root nuance recorded in docs/colosseum-lanista-verification.md. Steps: onboarding dismiss -> Tankoban entry -> Manga tab -> 'Top in Tankoban - Manga' rail (qml/TankobanMangaTab.qml, backed by the STATIC qml/Catalog.js#topManga list, so tile indices are deterministic, not live-ranked: index 0 = One Piece, index 1 = Berserk) -> masthead + shelf assertions on One Piece (catalogue-resolved malId 13, count_basis bookwalker, 112/113 baked covers - the COVERED branch) -> Slice 4's own picker assertions (nyaa-only, hasCompileFallback==false) on a shelf volume card, then series-mode search on Berserk (malId 2, volumeCount 0, an ONGOING series with no MAL count yet -> the honest shelf-less page, primaryAction=='search') -> regression: reopen the picker on a second card, world-tab away/back, reopen the series and confirm the masthead re-renders. Isolated tagged session, unique pipe, never the daily pipe; live-nyaa results are NOT asserted anywhere (network is not a deterministic gate) - every picker assertion here is structural (visibility, hasCompileFallback) only. Runtime-verification pass (arc-08 v2.3 volume-flow adoption, 2026-08-21, session 20260821-150503-d004f454): replayed clean against the adopted qml/MangaTankobanLibrary.qml/MangaReadingRoom.qml, every prior assertion held (coveredCount now 111/113, not 112 - the live db shifted by one between this pass's own two reads, pinned live not assumed). Added the 'flow proof' block (keyboard Right + action-bar label + click-to-centre-vs-click-to-act) below the shelf-state read - all reproduced reliably. Ground-truthed but NOT scripted here: a separate pristine replay (session 20260821-153445-cf852d97) found the picker-dismiss -> click-a-different-card path (this scenario's own 'regression: reopen the picker on a second card' step below) goes UNRESPONSIVE to clicks/scroll on the flow for several real seconds right after tankobanSourcesSheet closes, clearing on its own past roughly 6s - reproduced 3/3 fast attempts stuck, 1/1 slow (real 6s gap) attempt clean. Left the step below UNCHANGED (no schema-level sleep primitive to encode a reliable settle, and a blind retry-spam fix would be unverified) - flagged as a follow-up bug (not this adoption's own files - the freeze traces to qml/MangaTankobanSourcesPage.qml, untouched by ffd1eaa/ddae7d5) rather than silently patched or forced green. A literal fast replay of just that one step may time out; a naturally-paced replay (this file's own steps, run by a human-speed driver or with a few seconds between the dismiss and the retry) passes.
